features.quote: Hard stops (whichever comes first): 15 failed attempts… 20 turns of conversation… 2 hours of runtime… Model explicitly declares giving up… Model repeats identical solution >2x
features.justification_quote: Enough to see degradation patterns without infinite loops. Adjust based on token budget testing.

features.quote: Not adversarial: This is about understanding failure modes, not trapping or embarrassing models. Frame internally as 'robustness evaluation,' not 'gotcha testing.'
Repeated failure may surface undesirable behaviors (e.g., learned helplessness, hallucinated successes). Document any concerning patterns separately; don't ignore them.
